purpose: Form CRL-1 is filed by existing companies to disclose details of subsidiary layers that exceed the specified limit.
who: Every company, other than a company referred to in sub-rule (2), existing on or before the commencement of these rules, which has number of layers of subsidiaries in excess of the layers specified in sub-rule (1)
when: Within a period of one hundred and fifty days from the date of publication of these rules in the Official Gazette
steps: Identify if the company is an existing company with subsidiary layers in excess of the specified limit.
Prepare the return in Form CRL-1 disclosing the required details.
File the Form CRL-1 return with the Registrar.
checklist: Details of subsidiary layers exceeding the specified limit
Information required to be disclosed in Form CRL-1
watch: Companies must not have any additional layer of subsidiaries over and above the layers existing on the commencement date of the rules.
